text:
I can't make the choice for you, but here's how to decide:

## Quick Comparison

| Factor | **Rust** | **Go** |
|--------|----------|--------|
| **Learning Curve** | 🔴 Steep (memory safety) | 🟢 Gentle |
| **Conciseness** | 🔴 Verbose | 🟢 Clean |
| **Type Safety** | 🔒 Strong (compile-time) | 🟡 Moderate |
| **Error Handling** | 🔒 Result/Option (no null) | 🟡 Errors are values |
| **Concurrency** | 🔒 Async/await | 🟡 Goroutines |
| **Build Time** | 🔴 Slow (full type check) | 🟢 Fast |
| **Runtime** | 🟡 Small (no runtime) | 🟡 Small (no runtime) |

## When to Choose **Rust**

```
✅ Systems programming (OS, drivers)
✅ High-performance web servers
✅ Embedded devices
✅ When memory safety matters
✅ Learning functional patterns
```

**Pros:**
- Memory safety without garbage collection
- Zero-cost abstractions
- Strong type system catches bugs early
- Growing in web/mobile (AWS, Cloudflare, Microsoft)

**Cons:**
- Steep learning curve
- Verbose syntax
- Borrow checker frustration

## When to Choose **Go**

```
✅ Microservices/cloud-native
✅ CLI tools & APIs
✅ DevOps/infrastructure tools
✅ Rapid prototyping
✅ Team collaboration
```

**Pros:**
- Easy to learn (days vs months)
- Fast compilation
- Great for concurrent services
- Huge ecosystem (Docker, Kubernetes)

**Cons:**
- Less type safety
- Interface implementation is verbose
- Fewer libraries than other languages

## Decision Matrix

| Your Goal | Recommendation |
|-----------|---------------|
| **Learning systems programming** | ✅ Rust |
| **Starting backend work** | ✅ Go |
| **Job market entry** | ✅ Go (easier) |
| **Performance-critical** | ✅ Rust |
| **Fast prototyping** | ✅ Go |
| **Memory safety focus** | ✅ Rust |

## My Advice

**If you're new to systems programming:** Start with **Go** first for the fundamentals, then learn **Rust**.

**If you want immediate employability:** Go is widely used in cloud-native tech (Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform).

**If you're learning for fun:** Rust is more rewarding for understanding memory management.

## Career Reality

| Language | Job Growth | Avg Salary |
|----------|------------|------------|
| **Go** | 📈 Growing | $120k-$180k |
| **Rust** | 🚀 Exploding | $130k-$200k |

**TL;DR:** Go for speed & employability, Rust for deep understanding & performance! 🚀
